title: Step Functions falls back to Batch while a local worker is still generating the job
description: Seen during auritus-e7068b (2026-10-03). Job 6cb29cb1 was claimed by the local worker (~19:17Z) and generated for ~36 min. While it was still running, the record shows Batch claimed it at 19:47Z and completed it at 19:54Z. The stored audio was written by the local worker at 19:53:45Z (correct voice, verified), so readers get the right audio, but the job record names the wrong producer and Batch GPU time was spent on a job already in progress. Expected: the local-claim timeout / Batch fallback must not fire while the claiming local worker is still heartbeating; long local jobs (35+ min) need lease renewal rather than a fixed 15-min window. Also check whether a late Batch completion can overwrite a local result (here the local write landed first by chance). Related: auritus-d84350.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in the M3 claim-correctness PR (branch feat/m3-claim-correctness): claims carry a fencing token, heartbeats renew it, the fallback gate re-checks the claim in a conditional write. Close when that PR merges.
